tasks.analysis: Solon’s principal successor was Cleisthenes, who established democracy in Athens beginning in 508 B.C. He broadened the governmental base by opening it to all free male citizens (called the demos) regardless of their property or bloodlines. Cleisthenes’ democratic reforms, which lasted for almost two centuries, created an atmosphere in which civic pride and artistic energy were unleashed, inaugurating the Hellenistic Age that made Athens both the pride and the envy of the other Greek city-states. 梭伦的主要继承者是克利斯提尼，他于公元前 508 年开始在雅典建立民主制度。他扩大了政府的基础，将权力向所有自由男性公民（被称为 “demos”，即民众）开放，无论他们的财产状况或血统如何。克利斯提尼的民主改革持续了近两个世纪，创造了一种氛围，在这种氛围中，公民自豪感和艺术活力得以释放，开启了希腊化时代（ Hellenistic Age ）。这一时代使雅典成为其他希腊城邦既敬仰又羡慕的对象。
